head:
<!-- tll-dir-v1 · directory pages (/expats /creators /press) -->
<style>
.tlldir-page{background:#FDF9F3;color:#0A0B14;font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif}
.tlldir-wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
.tlldir-hero{background:#0A0B14;color:#F7F1E8;padding:72px 0 44px}
.tlldir-eyebrow{font:600 11.5px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#00C9C8}
.tlldir-h1{font-family:'Syne','Inter',sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(38px,6vw,68px);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:14px 0 18px}
.tlldir-h1 em{font-style:italic;color:#00C9C8}
.tlldir-lede{max-width:640px;font-size:17px;line-height:1.55;color:rgba(247,241,232,.82);margin:0}
.tlldir-tools{padding:26px 0 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #E0DACE}
.tlldir-search{width:100%;max-width:560px;padding:13px 16px;border:1.5px solid #0A0B14;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;font:inherit;font-size:15px}
.tlldir-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:12px;align-items:center}
.tlldir-chip{border:1.5px solid #0A0B14;background:transparent;color:#0A0B14;border-radius:999px;padding:7px 13px;font:600 12.5px/1 'Inter',sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.tlldir-chip[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#0A0B14;color:#F7F1E8}
.tlldir-tagrow .tlldir-chip{font:600 11px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 11px;border-color:#c9b89a}
.tlldir-tagrow .tlldir-chip[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:#0A0B14}
.tlldir-tagslabel{font:600 11px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#6B6660;margin:18px 0 8px}
.tlldir-count{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding:26px 0 14px;font:600 12px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tlldir-count span:last-child{color:#6B6660}
.tlldir-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:18px;padding-bottom:48px}
.tlldir-card{background:#fff;border:1.5px solid #E0DACE;border-radius:16px;padding:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;position:relative}
.tlldir-card--invite{border:1.5px dashed #c9b89a;background:transparent}
.tlldir-top{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center}
.tlldir-avatar{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:#0A0B14;color:#F7F1E8;display:grid;place-items:center;font:800 18px 'Syne','Inter',sans-serif;overflow:hidden;flex:none}
.tlldir-avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.tlldir-name{font:800 19px/1.15 'Syne','Inter',sans-serif;margin:0}
.tlldir-name a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.tlldir-sub{margin:3px 0 0;font-size:13.5px;color:#6B6660;line-height:1.4}
.tlldir-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.tlldir-tag{font:600 10.5px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid #c9b89a;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 9px;color:#0A0B14}
.tlldir-tag--amber{border-color:#D98A2B;color:#b8791f}
.tlldir-tag--teal{border-color:#067A79;color:#067A79}
.tlldir-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.tlldir-badge{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 9.5px 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;text-decoration:none;background:#0A0B14;color:#F7F1E8}
.tlldir-badge--ig{background:#F0507A;color:#fff}.tlldir-badge--tt{background:#0A0B14;color:#00C9C8}.tlldir-badge--yt{background:#C8425E;color:#fff}.tlldir-badge--ss{background:#D98A2B;color:#0A0B14}
.tlldir-contact{margin-left:auto;font:600 10.5px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#067A79;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid #067A79;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 10px}
.tlldir-report{font:600 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6B6660;text-decoration:none;margin-top:auto}
.tlldir-report:hover{color:#C8325B}
.tlldir-sample{font:600 10px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#6B6660;text-transform:uppercase}
.tlldir-plus{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px dashed #c9b89a;display:grid;place-items:center;font:300 28px/1 'Inter',sans-serif;color:#6B6660}
.tlldir-invite-link{font:600 12px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#C8325B;text-decoration:none}
.tlldir-empty{padding:40px 0 60px;max-width:560px}
.tlldir-empty h2{font:800 30px/1.1 'Syne','Inter',sans-serif;margin:0 0 10px}
.tlldir-cta{background:#0A0B14;color:#F7F1E8;padding:56px 0}
.tlldir-cta h2{font:800 clamp(28px,4vw,42px)/1.05 'Syne','Inter',sans-serif;margin:8px 0 12px}
.tlldir-cta p{color:rgba(247,241,232,.8);max-width:560px;margin:0 0 20px}
.tlldir-btn{display:inline-block;background:#F0507A;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font:700 13px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:14px 20px;border-radius:999px}
.tlldir-switch{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:14px 0 0}
.tlldir-switch a{font:600 11.5px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#F7F1E8;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid rgba(247,241,232,.35);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 13px}
.tlldir-switch a[aria-current="page"]{background:#F0507A;border-color:#F0507A}
.tlldir-src{display:none}
.tlldir-board{padding:40px 0 56px;border-top:1px solid #E0DACE}
.tlldir-board h2{font:800 30px/1.1 'Syne','Inter',sans-serif;margin:8px 0 10px}
.tlldir-board p{color:#6B6660;max-width:600px}
@media (max-width:640px){.tlldir-hero{padding:56px 0 34px}.tlldir-card{padding:16px}}
</style>
